text_block_list.text:
One day, while having lunch with Tokai 
Teio—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... As I thought, that's the secret 
to their power, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you at your limit yet? You've 
already eaten thirty bowls, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I have no limits! Seconds, please!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm tellin' ya, there is room in my 
stomach!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez was saying it, you know. She said, 
"Oguri possesses bottomless power."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Bottomless power... There are no limits...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if I push past my limits 
and eat even more, I should gain 
fathomless power too...!
choice_data_list: I don't think that's quite it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well then, what do you mean by that~?
choice_data_list: Why not observe a little more closely?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! She stood up... and went to get some 
salad!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I got it! Balanced nutrition with every 
meal! That's the real secret to strength, 
isn't it?♪

I had a feeling that wasn't quite what 
Symboli Rudolf meant to say... ...Well, I 
decided to just leave it at that for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll eat 30 bowls too— no, I'll 
surpass Oguri and—

...Needless to say, Tokai Teio's stomach 
subsequently reached its absolute limit...
